title: Night intrusion at the cabin when the implant was put in

tellings.quote: but as I'm turning, I see a woman standing at near the foot of the bed. She's already in the room and a man beside her. And I hear a voice in the backyard, male voice, go, "Condition red."

plain: One night in 1989 at his cabin in upstate New York, Whitley Strieber says he turned and saw a woman already in the room near the foot of the bed with a man beside her, while a male voice in the backyard said "Condition red"; he ties this night to an implant, a small object he says was placed in his body. Strieber, a writer who says he has met alien beings, tells Michels this as something he lived through. If true, it would mean people, not only beings, came into his home that night.
